verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse endpoint has built-in chunking (chunk_mode "variable", chunk_size) that removes the need for post-processing. Variable chunking splits at semantic boundaries such as section headers, tables and figures, and sizes chunks for embedding models. Parsed elements carry type, page position, confidence score and bounding boxes as metadata. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of chunk quality, explicit documentation of the per-chunk metadata/response schema.
